description:
Orbital Raceways
A monthly orbital frigate race with betting, High-stakes gambles, and a VIP-Lounge.

Manual download

Requirements

Starsector 0.98a-RC8
No other mods needed. No libraries or dependencies.

Save compatibility

Adding to an existing save: Moderate testing, 100% success rate.
Removing from a save:not safe. Removing the mod from a save in progress can cause errors, so please don't. If you want it out of your way, open the mod's Intel screen and turn Notifications to OFF. That hides its alerts, so you can ignore the races for the rest of your game.
Updating: this is the first release.

What it does
A race circuit opens above Asharu (you can change the host world in the config). Every month a new field of frigates takes the grid. Bet credits on the racers from the Intel screen during the first 7 days of the month. It adds a long-term credit sink and a bit of gambling flavor to the campaign.

What it Doesn't

Take over your game. The race is a monthly event that sits in the background of your normal Starsector play instead of monopolizing your time.
Make you participate. Use it as much or as little as you like. There is no penalty for falling behind and no bonus for getting a head start.
Reach into the rest of your game. Apart from the credits you win or lose, its effects are small and optional.
Promise success. The odds reflect those of real-world gambling. Good luck.

Race and Wagers: bet on a racer to win. The odds and payout are shown before you commit.
Standings: every pilot has an Elo rating and a recent record.
Membership and Rewards: earn Membership Rewards Points on your wagers and spend them as Fuel Points or Exclusive VIP Privileges.
December Grand Prix: a bigger field with win and podium wagers and better payouts.
VIP Sky Lounge: MEMBERS ONLY.
Special events: For VIP Members
Hostile fleets and raiders may interfere with the racers.

Odds
The odds shown are the real odds, no deception or rigged bets.

Install
Unzip so the OrbitalRaceways folder sits inside your Starsector mods folder, then enable it in the launcher.

Configuration
data/config/orbital_raceways.json holds the racer names and ships, win chances, bet sizes, house cut, special event costs and payouts, and the host world. Every setting has a comment. No recompiling needed.

FAQ
Do I need other mods?
No. It is standalone and does not replace any vanilla files. It adds one market condition (orbital_raceways) and a campaign script.

Can I move the circuit to another planet?
Yes. Set hostMarketId in the config file to the market id you want.

Can I change the racers?
Yes. Names, fleet names and ship variants are all in the config file.

Are there compatibility issues with other mods?
No, there should not be any mod compatibility issues and none came up in my extensive testing.

How do I get help with my gambling addiction?
You can reach the confidential National Problem Gambling Helpline 24/7 by calling 1-800-GAMBLER (1-800-522-4700) or texting 800GAM.

Can I move the circuit to another planet?
Yes. Set hostMarketId in the config file to the market id you want. If you have mods or settings enabled that alter the core worlds or the vanilla markets Asharu or Nomios, you will need to set the condition to a market that is present in your sector

AI use disclaimer
Some of the code and assets in this mod were created using AI tools:
Code: Claude (Anthropic). I directed the design, tested everything in game and made the balance decisions.
Graphics: Market Icon was generated with Gemini 3.5.

Credits and permissions
Made by coolestofguys. Feedback, bug reports and balance ideas are welcome. If you report a problem, please include your starsector.log.
